title: Bauval, Hancock and Schoch on Sphinx weathering and the Orion 10,500 BC alignment

tellings.quote: like Robert Bauval and Graham Hancock and Robert Schoch who since the 90s have been saying very interesting things about, you know, possibly limestone damage on the Sphinx

plain: Since the 1990s the writers Robert Bauval, Graham Hancock and Robert Schoch have argued that the limestone of the Sphinx in Egypt shows wear from weathering, and that the Giza monuments line up with the stars of Orion as they stood around 10,500 BC, which would make the site far older than usually thought. Michels sums up their work briefly, as "very interesting things" they have been saying, in an episode with a scientist who scanned beneath the pyramids.
